# reolink_push (Resource)

Manages Reolink Push notifications using GetPush and SetPush.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reolink_push" "front" {
  camera  = "front"
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `camera` (String) Key in the provider cameras map.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether camera push notifications are enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reolink_push.front front
```
